digest.component_or_area: plan-review severity axis; impact model floor logic
propositions: The undecomposed axis floors non-none grades to 0.85 impact uniformly regardless of severity level (low/medium/high), making low grades equivalent to high grades in blocking power.

The G5 deterministic suppressor cited as justification for the axis's low fire rate (0.07-0.15%) is inert: it fired zero times across 2,000 recorded reviews and applies only to the <10% of tickets with children.

The axis's 29 measured fires (11 plan-v3, 18 plan-v4) are genuine flat-plan defects; in 25 of 29 cases the undecomposed floor was the sole hard override present, and at least one low-grade fire blocked solely on the floor.
The inverse population (33 plan-v3 and 17 plan-v4 findings matching the undecomposed regex but graded none) are regex false positives about code/module decomposition, not missed flat-plan defects.
